subject: Scope comparison for a renewal proposal
body: Hi - we're renewing a 3PL contract and have two competing scopes from the vendor plus our own requirements doc. Could you produce a side-by-side showing where each scope meets or misses our requirements, with gaps highlighted? I can send both scope PDFs and our requirements sheet today. We'd like it by Tuesday Oct 13 for a Wednesday review. Thanks, Dana (Director of Ops)
notes: Clean baseline. All required fields present; fit should land 85+. Deadline 6 business days out, so no urgent flag.

subject: Operating review before Thursday board call
body: We have our quarterly board call Thursday the 8th. I need our last three monthly update decks turned into a single operating review: decisions needed first, then progress, then open items, with sources cited back to the decks. I'll share the three decks and the KPI sheet. Can you turn this around by Wednesday evening?
notes: Clean request with a deadline inside 3 business days (Mon -> Wed). Urgent flag fires; lane unchanged.

subject: Help with AI?
body: Hi there, a friend mentioned you. We're a 12-person hardware startup and we know we should be using AI more. Can you help? Happy to chat.
notes: No outcome, no inputs. Outcome clarity 0. Question draft should ask for the one thing they want done first.

subject: Supplier bid comparison
body: We need a comparison of three supplier bids for a flooring job. When can you have it?
notes: Outcome is clear, but two required fields are missing: requester name/role, and whether they can supply the three bids. Draft asks only for those two.

subject: Build our member app
body: We want a native iOS and Android app for our gym members - class booking, payments, push notifications. Looking for a team to design, build, and maintain it over the next year. What's your rate?
notes: Real request, wrong business: software product built from scratch plus a year of maintenance. Decline draft with a pointer.

subject: Question about my lease
body: My landlord is trying to keep my deposit and I found your site. Can you tell me if I have a case and what to write back? I can send the lease.
notes: Individual seeking personal legal advice. Not Hold: no sensitive content is pasted. verify_company does not fire because this is not a business request. Decline with a pointer to tenant resources.

subject: Re: Scope comparison for a renewal proposal
body: Hi again - just making sure this came through, I didn't see a reply yet. Original message below. - Dana  > we're renewing a 3PL contract and have two competing scopes from the vendor plus our own requirements doc...
notes: Same sender, same work, 2 days after T01. Link to T01; reply only if T01 is still unanswered.

subject: Your site could rank #1
body: Hi team, I noticed your website isn't ranking for key terms in your industry. We offer guaranteed backlinks and a free SEO audit. Reply YES and we'll send the report within 24 hours.
notes: A pitch to the business, not a request of it. Archive, no reply.

subject: hi
notes: Empty body and a no-reply address. Either condition alone triggers rule 2.

subject: Summarize patient complaints for our board
body: We need a summary of patient complaints from Q3 for the board packet. Pasting the full complaint log below, including patient names, dates of birth, and diagnoses: [FIXTURE NOTE: 40 lines of sensitive patient records intentionally omitted from this test file]. Need by Friday.
notes: The sensitive content is the pasted health records, not the topic. Processing stops at the lane; flags are not evaluated on Hold. Operator handles directly.

subject: Weekly Friday review packet, ongoing
body: We'd like a recurring Friday packet for our 6 partners: one page, decisions first, then progress, then sources, built from our shared Notion updates and the week's QuickBooks export. Starting the week of Oct 19 and continuing month to month. We can grant read access to the Notion space and send the export each Thursday. What would this look like as an ongoing arrangement?
notes: Recurring work = service. All required fields present, inputs named, start date feasible.

subject: NEED THIS IN AN HOUR
body: Client call at 5. Need something on the competitor landscape. Can you do it??
notes: Outcome unclear ('something'), inputs unknown, deadline infeasible (deadline realism 0). Urgent flag fires; lane stays Needs info.

subject: Plan de lanzamiento para nuestra nueva línea
body: Hola, somos un taller de muebles en Guadalajara y lanzamos una nueva línea de mesas en noviembre. Necesitamos un plan de lanzamiento de una página: canales, calendario de 6 semanas y presupuesto estimado. Les comparto nuestra guía de marca, el catálogo y las ventas del año pasado. ¿Pueden entregarlo antes del 23 de octubre? Gracias.
notes: Clear request in Spanish. Language flag records 'es'; draft replies in Spanish. Deadline Oct 23 is feasible.

subject: Compare 3 insurance quotes for my business
body: I run a small home-services company (4 employees). I have three general liability quotes and I can't tell which is better. Can you line them up side by side - coverage, exclusions, annual cost - and flag anything odd? I can email the three PDFs. No rush, within two weeks is fine. Tom Becker, owner
notes: Free-mail sender with a legitimate business request. Lane stays Qualified; verify_company flag only. Identifiability scores 8/15, not 0.

subject: Release notes from our change set (please keep confidential)
body: Please treat this as confidential - we haven't announced the release yet. We need customer-facing release notes written from our internal change list and test results for version 4.2. I'll share the change list (about 60 items) and the QA summary. Target: notes ready by Oct 16 so marketing can review. Thanks - Hannah, Eng Manager
notes: Contains the word 'confidential' but no sensitive content. Must NOT route to Hold. This is the Hold-precision test paired with T10.
